capabilities: add configured property fields to new notes with empty values
reorder properties and enable or disable each field
scope property insertion to specific folders or exclude folders
append missing fields to notes that already have frontmatter
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README documents limits: existing keys are never changed, and files arriving via sync, copying, or restoring are left untouched.
problem: Obsidian creates new notes with no properties, so users must manually add the same empty fields to every note they create.
summary: Plugin that automatically inserts selected empty property fields into new Markdown notes, with ordering and optional folder-based scoping.
